'''2004 DPC Carolina''' was the North Carolina DeckTech Player's Challenge, a Star Wars CCG constructed tournament played on 23 October 2004 at Fallen Orc Games, 114 Kilmayne Drive, Cary, North Carolina, during a DeckTech Player's Challenge weekend of 22–24 October 2004. The [[Players Committee]] and [[DeckTech]] announced it as the first SWCCG World Qualifier of the new season, with byes for first and second place into the [[2005 World Championship]].<ref name="pc-dpccar">[http://www.swccgpc.com/News/DPC%20Carolina%202004.htm North Carolina - DeckTech Player's Challenge - SWCCG Worlds Qualifier], swccgpc.com (October 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041216042614/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/DPC%20Carolina%202004.htm Internet Archive]</ref> [[Greyson Thompson]] and [[Adam Weinstein]] received the Day 2 byes.<ref name="pc-events05">[http://swccgpc.com/events.htm 2004/2005 Events: SWCCG 2005 Worlds Qualifiers Listing], swccgpc.com (updated 27 June 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050828001521/http://swccgpc.com:80/events.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date); announced as "Open Format"<ref name="pc-dpccar" />
* '''Site:''' Fallen Orc Games, 114 Kilmayne Drive, Cary, North Carolina<ref name="pc-dpccar" />
* '''Dates:''' 23 October 2004, 10:00 AM<ref name="pc-dpccar" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $10; decklist and tournament ticket required<ref name="pc-dpccar" />
* '''Structure:''' six games with a playoff<ref name="pc-dpccar" />
* '''Event coordinator:''' [[Patrick Hines]] (Star Wars CCG and WARS TCG judge)<ref name="pc-dpccar" />
* '''Event organizer:''' [[Don Weinstein]] ([[The Lord of the Rings Trading Card Game|LOTR TCG]] judge)<ref name="pc-dpccar" />
* '''Prizes:''' Day 2 byes for first and second place; uncut Star Wars CCG sheets for first, second and two random players; several booster boxes and tournament foils; more prizes depending on attendance<ref name="pc-dpccar" />
* '''Day 2 byes:''' [[Greyson Thompson]], [[Adam Weinstein]]<ref name="pc-events05" />

== Side events ==

The weekend also had a [[WARS TCG]] booster draft on Friday 22 October at 6:30 PM, a [[The Lord of the Rings Trading Card Game|Lord of the Rings TCG]] constructed (Standard format) event on Saturday 23 October at 6:00 PM and a WARS TCG constructed tournament on Sunday 24 October at 11:00 AM.<ref name="pc-dpccar" />
